notes.title: Patchnote v1.1
notes.content:
[u][b]Bug fixing[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] A truly invisible floor tile has been removed
[*] The correct version of the game is displayed on the pause screen
[*] Joysticks no longer make a horrible sound on menus [i](But please, use D-pad anyway)[/i]
[/list]

[u][b]Minor additions[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Slight zoom when hitting a wall. [i](Adds a little more dynamism)[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Move Dash Rush is available
notes.content:
It's Move Dash Rush day!
Warm up your fingers, it's going to go [i](very)[/i] fast.

A little old- school game whose appeal lies in highscore.
An introduction to speedrun, focusing on route finding.
The map offers several paths, and it's up to you to find the most optimized ones. 

I'm hopeful that this will be an attractive challenge for you.

If the game finds its audience and a small player base is formed, it's clearly not impossible that I'll add a second map to the game [i](free update)[/i].

Have fun!
